title: Speed colour, pushed further
question: Is the difference between a slow bubble and a fast one visible enough now?
context_md:
You said of the last one: *"This is the idea, but make the color change a little more visible. You are close."*

Same four settings of the dial in each pane — **x1 top-left, x2 top-right, x4 bottom-left, x8 bottom-right**. Only the ramp changed between the two panes.

I pushed both halves of it:

- **the hot end is warmer** — a warm gold rather than a near-white
- **a fast bubble is denser**, not just warmer. Measured: a x8 bubble now carries **1.72x** the tint of a x1 one, against 1.37x before

**One thing I deliberately did not do, and it is the ceiling on this.** Pushing the hot end further means going into amber — and amber is already the colour of the bubble *he is carrying*. Past about here, a fast placed bubble starts reading as his own bubble, and I would be buying one distinction by spending another. If you want it hotter still, tell me and I will take the carried bubble somewhere else first rather than let the two collide.

The shimmer speed is unchanged and identical in every tile — that is the part you asked to stop moving with the dial.

items.caption: the ramp you saw: hot end near-white, density 1.45x

items.label: after
items.caption: hot end warmed to gold, density 2.0x
